fee_notes: Two purchase options: (1) 10-Year Agreement: lump-sum Franchise Fee of $24,900 plus Territory Fee of $15,000 = $39,900 total initial fees. (2) 5-Year Agreement: monthly Franchise Fee of $500/month (estimated $1,500 for up to 3 months pre-launch) plus Territory Fee of $15,000 = $16,500 total initial fees prior to Business Launch Date. Territory Fee is $15,000 for up to 79,999 children in the Network Area. A 10% discount ($2,490) applies to the Franchise Fee for existing franchisees adding a unit under a 10-Year Agreement, and a 10% discount applies for U.S. Armed Forces veterans on the 10-Year Agreement Franchise Fee.
raw_excerpt: In the 10-Year Agreement, the initial fees payable to us when you sign the Area Developer Agreement include both the Franchise Fee and the Territory Fee (as both terms are defined below) in a lump sum amount of $39,900. In the 5-Year Agreement, only the Territory Fee is required as an initial fee when you sign the Area Developer Agreement. The initial fees for both options are as follows: [10-Year Agreement: Franchise Fee $24,900, Territory Fee $15,000, Total Initial Fees $39,900] [5-Year Agreement: Franchise Fee $500 per month, Territory Fee $15,000, Total $16,500]
